{{CharInfobox| |color={{psychic color}} |corecolor={{psychic color light}} |bordercolor={{flying color dark}} |name=Anela |jname=モアニ |tmname=Moani |image=Anela.png |caption=Anela |size=250px |hometown=[[Hau'oli City]] |region=[[Alola]] |trainer=no |game=no |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Gray |anime=yes |epnum=SM004 |epname=First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style! |enva=[[Rosie Reyes]] |java=[[Rikako Aikawa]] }} '''Anela''' (Japanese: '''モアニ''' ''Moani'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. She is a friend of [[Ash's Incineroar]] and runs a fruit stall in the [[Hau'oli City]] marketplace. ==History== Anela debuted in ''[[SM004|First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!]]'', where she provided {{p|Litten}} some {{Berries}}. After spotting a flock of {{DL|Toucannon's flock|Pikipek}}, {{DL|Toucannon's flock|Trumbeak}}, and {{AP|Rowlet}} fly overhead, she explained to Litten that the flock visits the market every year to collect food. Anela happily donated some fruit to the {{type|Flying}} Pokémon. In ''[[SM007|That's Why the Litten is a Scamp!‬]]'', Anela provided Litten with some more Berries and explained to {{Ash}} and {{an|Professor Kukui}} that Litten does this every day. In ''[[SM021|One Journey Ends, Another Begins...]]'', Anela picked up a doughnut that had fallen out of Ash's [[bag]]. She went to give it back to Ash only for Litten to grab it and run off. Ash also visited her following {{an|Stoutland}}'s disappearance. Anela gave him some Berries to deliver to Litten and instructed him to tell Litten it could come to the marketplace anytime. Anela has attended multiple events at the [[Pokémon School]], including the Family Visit Day in ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'' and the school play in ''[[SM093|Lillier and the Staff!]]''. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} often visit Anela's fruit stall, where she offers them and their Pokémon bowls of produce free of charge, like in ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]'' and ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]''. In ''[[SM102|Alola, Alola!]]'', she met {{an|Misty}} who was visiting [[Alola]] and laughed after {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} swallowed a watermelon whole. She attended Professor Kukui and {{an|Professor Burnet}}'s wedding in ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]''. In the [[Banned episodes|banned episode]] [[SM064]], Anela got to meet Litten for the first time after its Evolution into {{AP|Torracat}} and gave it some [[Sitrus Berry|Sitrus Berries]] to eat. She also witnessed a fight between two groups of {{p|Passimian}}. [[File:Anela Dancer.png|thumb|250px|Anela wearing her Dancer dress]] In ''[[SM082|All They Want to Do is Dance Dance!]]'', Anela's name was finally revealed by {{an|Mallow}}. Anela met Mallow and {{p|Steenee}} in the market place where she gave Steenee some fruit and watched as it danced. She went on to show Mallow the Hula Dance and brought out her {{p|Oricorio}} to perform it on the street, which inspired Mallow and Steenee to do it for their upcoming Pokémon Dance performance. She was invited to the Pokémon School for a Pokémon Dance presentation, where it was revealed that she used to be a {{tc|Dancer}}. She was later trapped by {{TRT}} and watched as Steenee [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{TP|Mallow|Tsareena}}. In ''[[SM083|Dummy, You Shrunk the Kids!]]'', Anela offered an apple to a shrunken {{an|Sophocles}} and his {{TP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}}, before Ash and {{an|Lillie}} arrived at her stall. In ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]'', Anela joined the rest of Alola in showering {{an|Necrozma}} with light so it could return to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|true form}}. In ''[[SM124|Living on the Cutting Edge!]]'', Anela had her fruit cut by a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Kartana}}. She later explained the incident to Ash, who was searching for Kartana. She then gave some sliced fruit to him and his Pokémon to enjoy. ==Character== Anela has an affable and generous personality, as shown through her [[friendship]] with {{AP|Litten}}. She is a community-minded individual and enjoys an event-filled calendar outside of her role as a greengrocer. In ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'', she delivered [[Berry|Berries]] to [[Nurse Joy]] after learning that she was unwell. Anela often gives {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}} and their Pokémon bowls of fruit, free of charge, when they visit her stall. This comes from Anela's generous heart and her love and respect for nature, often citing that nature's bounty is for everyone to share and enjoy. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Anela |pkmn=Oricorio |nick=Dori-chan |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=Anela Dori-chan.png |epnum=SM082 |epname=All They Want to Do is Dance Dance! |vajp= |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Oricorio}}, [[nickname]]d (Japanese '''ドリちゃん''' ''Dori-chan''), is Anela's only known Pokémon. It first appeared in ''[[SM082|All They Want to Do is Dance Dance!]]'', where it was used to help [[Mallow's Steenee]] perfect her dance for Mallow's upcoming dancing class at the [[Pokémon School]]. It and its Trainer later gave a Pokémon Dance presentation before {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}}. Dori-chan reappeared in ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]'', where she joined the rest of Alola in showering {{an|Necrozma}} with light so it could return to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|true form}}. None of Oricorio's moves are known.}} ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ash |pkmn=Litten |main=yes |type1=Fire |img=Ash Litten.png |epnum=SM001 |epname=Alola to New Adventure! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Lisa Ortiz |desc={{p|Litten}} was a [[wild Pokémon]] that Anela was happy to hand out food to.
